key.name: pinned-metrics
key.description: List of metrics to show in the top bar.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Whole seconds. Replaced by poll-interval-ms; a value here is moved there once and reset.

key.name: poll-interval-ms
key.description: Time between two readings, in milliseconds (250 to 30000).

key.name: unit-temp
key.description: Temperature unit (C or F).

key.name: unit-mem
key.description: Memory unit (GB or GiB).

key.name: compact-label
key.description: Show icons only in the top bar indicator without text labels.

key.name: threshold-cpu
key.description: CPU percentage threshold to trigger warning style.

key.name: threshold-mem
key.description: Memory percentage threshold to trigger warning style.

key.name: threshold-temp
key.description: Temperature threshold to trigger warning style.

key.name: threshold-gpu
key.description: GPU usage percentage that raises an alert when sustained.

key.name: threshold-disk
key.description: Percentage of space used on / that raises an alert.

key.name: threshold-battery
key.description: Battery charge, while running on battery, at or below which an alert is raised.

key.name: smooth-transitions
key.description: Shown values glide to each new reading over one polling interval; noisy rates are lightly averaged. Alerts and history use the raw readings.

key.name: alert-notify
key.description: Send a desktop notification when a metric stays above its threshold.

key.name: show-tooltips
key.description: Show rich contextual hover tooltips on panel indicators.

key.name: battery-top-format
key.description: Format of battery metric in top bar ('percent' or 'percent-time').

key.name: network-top-format
key.description: Format of network metric in top bar ('download', 'upload', or 'both').

key.name: menu-custom-width
key.description: User-resized width of the dropdown panel in pixels (0 for default).

key.name: menu-custom-height
key.description: User-resized height of the dropdown panel in pixels (0 for default).

key.name: panel-shortcut
key.description: Key combination that opens and closes the panel. Empty: none.

key.name: action-open-menu
key.description: Writing true opens the extension menu.

key.name: battery-tracking
key.description: Sample per-app CPU time and energy every 30 seconds and keep 14 days of hourly totals in ~/.local/share/resource-pulse/battery-history.json. Off until the user starts it.

key.name: prefs-page
key.summary: Page the preferences window opens on
key.description: Set by the panel before it opens the window (settings, tracking or diagnostics); the window clears it. A window opened without it (from the Extensions app) shows the settings only.

key.name: action-flush-history
key.summary: Trigger for saving the battery history now
key.description: Writing true makes the extension write its battery history file at once (the preferences window does this to show current figures).

key.name: action-clear-history
key.summary: Trigger for clearing the battery history
key.description: Writing true deletes all recorded battery history.

key.name: agent-consent
key.summary: Agents the user agreed to send the report to
key.description: Set when the user confirms the first hand-off to an agent. Not kept in settings backups.

key.name: overview-card-order
key.description: Display order of metric cards inside the overview panel.
